adds.title: Danish Parliament decision to remove Gender Identity Disorder from National Board of Health list - decided 2016, effective 1 January 2017; WHO action June 2018
adds.summary: In May 2016 Denmark announced it would stop classifying transgender identity as a mental illness/behavioural disorder under WHO ICD standards and would act unilaterally by October 2016 if WHO did not remove the gender identity disorder classification, establishing trans identity as not mentally disordered and requiring a neutral non-stigmatizing diagnosis.
